Linux 7.0.0-38-generic x86_64 · NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 · driver 580.178.04 · ORT 1.24.3

Explicit hybrid mode uses keyword + vector + cross-encoder reranking; learned-sparse is off. MIRACL: dev split.

### mixed/legal-clerc-200

**hybrid: WITHHELD.** Under the default 200 ms reranker budget, the cross-encoder missed its deadline on 25/200 queries (12.5%) of roughly 260 words on this machine; 174/200 were reranked, with one deterministic navigational skip. Harness verdict: degraded-ce, not comparable. An earlier run under heavier load had 60% deadline misses. Hybrid quality and its regression floor are withheld; lexical/vector/splade ablations remain available for this 198-document pool, all documents judged relevant to at least one query. No hybrid regression floor is published. See the methodology for the lexical/vector/splade ablations and corpus caveat.
